issues.title: Illegible text contrast
issues.description: Assistant message text color blends into the dark background, rendering it nearly unreadable.
issues.evidence: The body text starting with 'Yes — v2.7 is green...' and its bullet points are barely visible against the dark canvas.
issues.suggestion: Apply high-contrast dark theme text tokens for body copy.
issues.triageNote: Real: static text-neutral-100 inverts to near-black (rgb 21 21 19) on the dark canvas (rgb 11 11 10) ≈ 1.1:1; fixed by theme-aware text-default-font ink over a root bg-default-background canvas token.

issues.title: Illegible low-contrast body text
issues.description: Assistant message body copy fails WCAG contrast requirements against the dark canvas token.
issues.evidence: Paragraphs and bullet items below the copilot status header blend into the dark background.
issues.suggestion: Increase text color to a higher-contrast neutral token.
issues.triageNote: Real: same root cause as pair-092 on the dark bg-default-background canvas (RTL page); fixed by the same semantic-token change.

issues.title: Low contrast callout text
issues.description: The blockquote text inside the assistant card has low contrast against the light container surface.
issues.evidence: Muted gray text 'WCAG 2.1 AA needs 4.5:1 for text.' on light beige card background.
issues.suggestion: Increase font weight or darken the text token to ensure WCAG AA compliance.
issues.triageNote: Real defect class: text-neutral-400 fails AA on the canvas in both themes (≈2.5:1 dark, ≈2.1:1 light); stepped the quote to neutral-600 (≈7.9:1 dark / ≈5.1:1 light over the component's canvas-token surface).

issues.title: Unmirrored quote accent border in RTL
issues.description: The callout quote uses a physical left border rather than a logical inline-start border.
issues.evidence: Vertical accent line appears on the left edge while in RTL direction.
issues.suggestion: Use logical border-inline-start to mirror border placement in RTL.
issues.triageNote: Real: physical border-l-2/pl-4 on the Quote; replaced with logical border-s-2/ps-4 so the accent strip mirrors to the inline-start edge in RTL.
